# InMobi
> AI and consumer-first technology company powering mobile advertising, app growth, commerce media, and connected consumer experiences.

InMobi builds technology for advertisers, publishers, app developers, and commerce platforms across mobile marketing, monetization, identity, and retail media. Its web presence spans product overviews, solutions, company resources, blogs, and developer-facing documentation for key platforms.

## Company
- [Home](https://www.inmobi.com/): Overview of InMobi’s AI-powered consumer technology and mobile experience platform.
- [About](https://www.inmobi.com/company/about-us): Company background, mission, scale, and business focus areas.
- [Leadership](https://www.inmobi.com/company/leadership): Executive leadership team and company management profiles.
- [Careers](https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers): Open roles, culture, and hiring information across InMobi teams.
- [Contact](https://www.inmobi.com/contact-us): Contact options for business, partnerships, and general inquiries.
- [Newsroom](https://www.inmobi.com/company/newsroom): Press releases, announcements, and media coverage highlights.

## Advertising Solutions
- [Advertising](https://www.inmobi.com/advertising): Overview of advertising products for brands, agencies, and performance marketers.
- [Brand Advertising](https://www.inmobi.com/advertising/brand-advertising): Solutions for awareness, reach, and brand impact on mobile media.
- [Performance Advertising](https://www.inmobi.com/advertising/performance-advertising): Campaign products focused on installs, actions, and measurable outcomes.
- [Programmatic Advertising](https://www.inmobi.com/advertising/programmatic): Programmatic media buying and audience activation capabilities.
- [Creative Solutions](https://www.inmobi.com/advertising/creative-solutions): Ad formats and creative experiences designed for mobile engagement.
- [Measurement](https://www.inmobi.com/advertising/measurement): Measurement, attribution, and campaign effectiveness capabilities.

## Publisher & Monetization
- [Publishers](https://www.inmobi.com/publishers): Monetization solutions for app publishers and media owners.
- [App Monetization](https://www.inmobi.com/publishers/app-monetization): Revenue optimization tools for mobile app inventory and demand.
- [Programmatic Monetization](https://www.inmobi.com/publishers/programmatic): Programmatic demand access and yield management for publishers.
- [Ad Formats](https://www.inmobi.com/publishers/ad-formats): Supported ad experiences and monetization-ready mobile formats.
- [Publisher Support](https://www.inmobi.com/publishers/support): Help resources and operational support for publisher partners.

## Glance
- [Glance](https://www.inmobi.com/glance): Consumer platform delivering lock-screen and ambient content experiences.
- [Glance for Consumers](https://www.inmobi.com/glance/consumers): Overview of personalized content and discovery experiences for users.
- [Glance for Partners](https://www.inmobi.com/glance/partners): Partnership opportunities for device makers, carriers, and ecosystem participants.
- [Glance News](https://www.inmobi.com/glance/news): Updates, announcements, and stories related to the Glance platform.

## Commerce & Retail Media
- [Commerce Media](https://www.inmobi.com/commerce-media): Retail and commerce media solutions for advertisers and marketplaces.
- [Retail Media](https://www.inmobi.com/commerce-media/retail-media): Media monetization and ad platform capabilities for retailers.
- [Commerce Insights](https://www.inmobi.com/commerce-media/insights): Data-driven insights and audience intelligence for commerce campaigns.
- [Commerce Measurement](https://www.inmobi.com/commerce-media/measurement): Measurement and performance analytics for commerce media programs.
